Thammasat Student Dormitory - Tha Prachan
Location & General Info
For on-campus housing, Thammasat offers the “TU Dorm Tha Prachan,” located approximately 40 minutes from the Tha Prachan campus. A shuttle bus service is available to transport students between the dormitory and the campus. Travel time to Tha Prachan campus: ~30–45 minutes by bus or shuttle

Thammasat Student Dormitory - Rangsit Centre
Thammasat University’s largest campus offers a variety of accommodation options, both on and off-campus. The most well-known on-campus option is the ASEAN Games Dormitories in Zones B, C, and E, providing 2- and 4-bedroom units, sized at 35m2 and 70m2, respectively. In-room amenities include beds, bedside tables, writing desks, chairs, wardrobes, air-conditioning, water heaters, smoke detectors, ADSL phone lines at a special rate, 64-channel satellite TV, clothes airier, utility areas, sofas, 4-seat dining tables, refrigerators, and televisions. Outside the rooms, facilities such as microwave ovens, hot and cold-water dispensers, water purifiers, coin-operated laundry machines, free WiFi, CCTV and lifts are available.
The surrounding areas offer a range of facilities, including Tewson Canteen, the Inter Zone Building, convenience stores, bookstores, three nearby 7-Elevens, a computer repair shop, six reasonably priced laundry shops located in Buildings A2, B3, B7, C1, C5, and C10. Each building also has 3-4 coin-operated laundry machines and beverage vending machines. Nearby street markets and parks provide recreational opportunities for residents. For reservation of our on-campus dormitory, visit
https://precheckin.psm.tu.ac.th/auth/login
